_meta.source: Round 15 - Direct source verification (Harvard CDS PDF, MIT admissions stats, Purdue CDS PDF)
_meta.purpose: Elite university residency admit rates from official primary sources
_meta.verifiedBy: Direct PDF download + pdftotext extraction; MIT official admissions stats page

schools.notes: Harvard CDS 2024-25 C1 (PDF): applied 54,008 (in-state 3,032 / oos 34,216 / intl 16,760), admitted 1,970 (in-state 265 / oos 1,380 / intl 325). Intl 1.94% markedly lower than domestic (4-9%). Elite school with very limited intl capacity relative to demand.

MIT Admissions Stats (official page): applied 29,281 total / intl 6,926, admitted 1,334 total / intl 136. Intl 1.96% vs overall 4.55%. U.S./PR: 22,355 applied / 1,198 admitted = 5.36%. MIT does not publish in-state vs OOS breakdown separately.

Purdue CDS 2025-26 C1 (Fall 2025 data): applied 87,220 (in-state 12,040 / oos 58,853 / intl 16,327), admitted 37,881 (in-state 8,559 / oos 25,650 / intl 3,672). Intl 22.5% notably lower than domestic. OOS nearly same as overall (dominant applicant pool). In-state very high at 71%.
